The shape of authority
The Feudal Stewardship at Quillmarsh watches the thorp's temper closely: what it fears is the thorp turning on it.
Rule and succession
If anyone at Quillmarsh asked who might replace the Feudal Stewardship, the thorp would have no contender to name.
Everything in Quillmarsh looks recently built, because most of it was.
Nobody in Quillmarsh has finished putting right the legacy the religious conflict left, and that legacy is a generation old.
